highlights: Save seed straight from a planting — one tap on the planting page creates the lot, already linked to the plant it came from
Planting pages now show the seed you've already saved from that plant, so you can check before saving again
Saving seed is logged on the plant's timeline and counts toward your streak and XP
Seed still fermenting or drying no longer shows up as ready to sow; it stays on the list, clearly marked, and becomes sowable when you mark it stored
The seed picker now has a search box and shows quantity, source and date on each row, so two packets of the same variety are no longer identical lines
You're asked how much seed you got when you mark a lot stored — not when you save it, when it's still wet and uncounted
Record where non-garden seed came from — store-bought, gift, u-pick, foraged
See a seed lot's full history on its own page, and fix a stage you tapped by mistake
Seed drying guidance corrected: the old example named a dehydrator temperature that kills the lot
Ferment now warns at day 4 and alarms at day 5, before the seed sprouts in the jar
